summary: A lane report discharges its lane's declared evidence obligations: report evidence entries become typed obligation and detail pairs over one closed vocabulary shared by the lane and report contracts, the discharged evidence joins the worker.completed payload at version 2 with an explicit reported or legacy_unavailable origin, and a completion leaving any declared obligation undischarged is refused in the fold and recorded as a typed invalid_report failure instead.
title: A lane report discharges its lane's evidence obligations
